answer: Identities enter a bonding-curve escrow: first slots cost a 15-unit bond locked 60 days, and the price rises 20% after every 10 admissions. An attacker minting 100 identities climbs every tier, locking about 3,900 units, and since all bonds stay locked at once, capital cannot be recycled between them. Activation needs six work rounds 12+ hours apart, each producing distinct verifiable output (labeling an opal specimen, a ridge panorama, a basalt outcrop), checked by five random peers. The escrow verifies tier, lock age, and sign-off before rewards vest; duplicate output slashes the bond.
